plans.idea: Classic centred poster: the headline and subhead sit as one block slightly above optical centre, with the legal line centred on the bottom margin. This fixes the current top-heavy layout that leaves the lower half empty and puts the legal line off-axis on the left.

Narrow, tall text column that forces the headline into a big three- or four-line stacked statement (white then gold) filling the square's height, with the orange subhead tucked under it as a sign-off and the legal line centred below on the same axis.

Editorial bottom-left anchor: the headline and subhead sit in the lower-left as a heavy block on a shared left edge, with the legal line flush-left beneath it. Open dark space above gives a calm 'sunset' feel and reads as a deliberate asymmetric composition rather than a shrunk copy.
